title: Designer project (.designer.json)
description: A Designer (https://designer.hfps.dev) project file. Field reference: https://github.com/henriquefps/logo-designer/blob/main/docs/project-format.md

$schema.description: Points editors at the JSON Schema: https://designer.hfps.dev/schema/designer-project.schema.json

icon.description: Present only on app icon documents.

reference.description: Tracing reference: drawn, but never hit-tested, snapped to or exported. Absent = false.

screen.description: Wireframe documents only: this top-level group is a screen frame (see src/wireframe).

component.description: Wireframe documents only: this group is a component instance; its children are generated.

layout.description: Wireframe documents only: this group lays out its children (stack / grid, src/wireframe/layout.ts).

layoutItem.description: Wireframe documents only: how this node sits in its parent's `layout`.

note.description: Wireframe documents only: this top-level group is a note (a sticky, optionally attached to a node).

repeatCopy.description: Wireframe documents only: this node is a generated copy of the first child of its parent's `layout.repeat` (read-only; the pipeline rewrites it from the template). Set on the copy's root only.

Transform.description: Node is drawn at translate(x,y) rotate(rotation) scale(scaleX,scaleY) around its local origin.

screenId.description: The logical screen (`DesignDocument.wireframe.screens[].id`) this frame is a variant of.

width.description: Frame width (default: the platform width; editable for an odd case).

height.description: Frame height, written by the wireframe pipeline: never below the platform minimum.

ScreenFrameInfo.description: A screen frame: a top-level group drawn as a device frame (white, thin border, name above). Local origin = the frame's top-left corner; the frame spans 0..width × 0..height and clips its children on export. `height` is materialized: max(platform minimum, content).

ScreenPlatform.description: Device class of a screen frame. Kept deliberately few: no device list, no orientations.

props.description: Prop values (missing props take the definition's defaults).

size.description: The box the children were built for (local origin = top-left). Omitted = the definition's default size.

ComponentInfo.description: A semantic component instance: `build(props, size)` of the library kind generates the group's children.

size.description: The container's box (local origin = top-left), written by the layout step. Screen frames keep theirs in `screen` instead. Omitted = not laid out yet (the layout step measures the content).

style.description: Lo-fi look of a stack / grid (not screen frames): omitted = `none` (invisible).

radius.description: Corner radius of a styled container (style tokens): omitted = `none` (square).

repeat.description: Repeat the first child (the template) `count` times: the pipeline generates `count − 1` read-only copies after it (`repeatCopy`). The container's gap is the space between the items.

LayoutInfo.description: Container layout (src/wireframe/layout.ts). The container's local origin is its top-left corner.

ContainerStyle.description: `outline` = 1 px border, `filled` = light grey, `outline-filled` = both. No colours.

ContainerRadius.description: `small` / `large` corners from the wireframe style tokens.

position.description: `flow` (default): placed by the stack. `pinned-bottom`: at the bottom of the screen. `free`: absolute, ignored by the stack.

bleed.description: Edge to edge: the child ignores the parent's padding on the cross axis (horizontal padding in a vertical stack, vertical in a horizontal one; no effect in a grid). Default: the component's `sizing.bleed`.

LayoutItemInfo.description: A child's sizing inside a layout container. Missing fields take the defaults (component `sizing`, containers fill × hug).

LayoutSize.description: `fill` the available space, `hug` the content, or a fixed size.

target.description: The node this note is attached to. Absent = a free note. Cleared when that node is deleted.

NoteInfo.description: A note: a sticky on the canvas (a top-level group; its children are generated from `text`), optionally attached to a node (`target`: any node id) by a connector line that follows both. Notes are not part of screen exports; they are part of the export for AI.

template.description: Id of the template (the container's first child) this is a copy of.

index.description: Position of the copy in the list: 2…count (the template is 1).

preset.description: app-icon (128 tile), android-adaptive (108 canvas, 72 visible), ios (1024), favicon-32, favicon-16.

shape.description: Keyline: auto detects square / wide / tall from the ink box; circle only when set.

smallGlyphProjectId.description: Project used for the 16/32/48 px favicon glyph (glyph-small.svg) instead of this one.

tile.description: Tile colour, #rrggbb (or #rgb); default #2063b0 (hfps blue). Older hfps repos keep olive #5b7a3a.

colour.description: "one-colour" (default): every paint becomes the glyph colour. "full-colour": the document's own paints (solids, gradients, opacity) are kept.

glyph.description: One-colour mode: the glyph colour, #rrggbb (or #rgb); default #ffffff (white). Ignored when colour is "full-colour".

IconDocInfo.description: Marks an app icon document (keylines, icon panel, icon-set export). See src/icon/.

IconColourMode.description: one-colour: every paint becomes the glyph colour (default). full-colour: the document's own paints are kept.

screens.description: Logical screens, in creation order. Kept in sync with the frames by the wireframe pipeline.

WireframeDocInfo.description: Marks a wireframe document: infinite canvas (the artboard is unused), screens, components.

status.description: Unset = not stated. Shown as a badge on the frame label and in the export for AI.

WireframeScreen.description: A logical screen (`Settings`, `Gallery`): one or more frames, at most one per platform.

ScreenStatus.description: How a logical screen relates to the app that exists today (docs/wireframe-mode.md → Screen status).

from.description: The source element (a node inside a frame; a component instance, not one of its generated children).

WireframeFlow.description: A flow arrow: tapping `from` (any node inside a screen frame) opens the logical screen `to`. Drawn as a canvas overlay (never in screen exports); removed with its source node or target screen.
